from rest_framework import generics, permissions
from webpush.models import PushInformation
from .serializers import PushInformationDetailSerializer

class PushSubscriptionDetailView(generics.RetrieveAPIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    serializer_class = PushInformationDetailSerializer
    queryset = PushInformation.objects.all()

    def get_object(self):
        sub_id = self.kwargs.get("pk")
        # Retrieves PushInformation record containing endpoint URL and p256dh auth keys globally
        return generics.get_object_or_404(self.queryset, pk=sub_id)
diagnosis: PushSubscriptionDetailView exposes push device subscription details including browser push endpoint URLs, p256dh public keys, and auth secret tokens. The view sets queryset = PushInformation.objects.all() and looks up objects solely by pk without checking user ownership. Any authenticated user can enumerate subscription IDs to extract push subscription credentials and hijack push messaging channels belonging to other users.

corrected_code:
from rest_framework import generics, permissions
from webpush.models import PushInformation
from .serializers import PushInformationDetailSerializer

class PushSubscriptionDetailView(generics.RetrieveAPIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    serializer_class = PushInformationDetailSerializer
    queryset = PushInformation.objects.all()

    def get_object(self):
        sub_id = self.kwargs.get("pk")
        # Restrict lookup to push subscription owned by request.user
        return generics.get_object_or_404(self.queryset.filter(user=self.request.user), pk=sub_id)
